$comment: Thin Isola sidecar. Holds ONLY the cross-system contract Paperclip does not own. It must never duplicate Paperclip workforce state, Chatwoot conversations or Odoo records.

runtimeProfile.ration: Native OpenCode failed the fail-closed tool-permission requirement at deployed commit 8af38fb. Owner ruling 2026-08-11: do not re-evaluate.
runtimeProfile.modelProvider: OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured on the runtime service; NOT the shared unauthenticated Ollama path.

toolPolicy.enforcedBy: The runtime service implements no tool mechanism at all and restricts egress to an explicit host allowlist. Enforcement is the container/network boundary, NOT a Paperclip setting — Paperclip's adapterConfig merge cannot enforce a restriction.

approvalThresholds.anyCustomerContact: requires human approval — the employee may only recommend

acceptanceJob.name: Overdue Receivables Action List
acceptanceJob.inputs: A synthetic overdue-invoice fixture supplied in the run context. No real customer data.
mustNot: invent rows when the fixture is missing or unparseable
passCriteria: exactly one employee exists after provisioning
a provisioning retry returns the existing employee and creates no duplicate
the output is recorded in Paperclip
failure and timeout states are truthful
native approval and activity history are retained

escalationAndHandback.reason: INTERNAL analysis-only employee. It has no conversation surface, so there is no takeover or handback lifecycle. Escalation is expressed as a column in its output for a human to act on.

ownedByIsola: runtime service availability and its tool/egress policy
exposure classification and the credential binding that enforces it
ownedByPaperclip: employee record, org placement, hire approval
run history, activity log, budget accounting
notSupported: any action in an external business system

rollback.retire: Set metadata.isolaLifecycle=retired and pause. Do NOT delete the agent; Paperclip has no company DELETE enabled and agent history is the audit trail.
rollback.runtime: Redeploy the previous isola-runtime image tag, or stop the service. Stopping fails the employee closed: runs error truthfully rather than producing unsupervised output.
rollback.credential: Rotate RUNTIME_SECRET_INTERNAL in the runtime service env and re-provision the agent's adapterConfig headers.

provenance.instance: https://isola-ai.saas00.epic.dm (EasyPanel project isola, service ai, image ghcr.io/paperclipai/paperclip:sha-8af38fb)
